prompts.text: In one sentence, explain the difference between latency and throughput.
Explain how gradient checkpointing reduces memory during neural-network training. Include its compute tradeoff and one practical limitation.
Write a Python function that merges two sorted integer lists in O(n) time. Include a docstring and three assert-based tests.
Return only valid JSON with keys name, version, and deps, where deps is an array of exactly three strings.
A train leaves at 14:05 traveling 80 km/h. Another leaves the same station at 14:35 traveling 120 km/h on the same route. At what time does the second train catch the first? Show the calculation.
